prompts.dojo: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied existing pixel-art fighting-game stage. Outpaint ONLY horizontally to produce a seamless 8:3 panoramic image (e.g. 2880x1080). Original 16:9 image should occupy the CENTER TWO THIRDS at unchanged proportions and visual scale. Extend canvas by 25% of original width on each side. Preserve original central composition, pixel-art palette, light direction, pixel clusters, sharp detailed arcade-anime aesthetic, horizon, vanishing points, buildings and floor elevation. Generate new asymmetric architecture and scenery continuing beyond both edges. NO mirroring, repeated tiles, copy-paste buildings, stretching, borders, panels or seams. The foreground fighting floor must extend across the full width as a level unobstructed strip at identical height to reference, especially at 85% image height. No fighters, interface, text captions or foreground obstacles. Unique left and right extensions, natural continuous ground texture. Left extension: bamboo garden path, mossy stone retaining wall, small shrine alcove. Right: continuation of dojo side veranda and stone lantern garden. Preserve moonlit blue mountains and warm lantern light.
